newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Ibex starts down 1.56 pct on Wall St dive.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Ibex starts down 1.56 pct on Wall St dive.

text.p: Spain's Ibex-35 blue chip stock index opened down 1.56 percent to 6,695.12 on Tuesday in the wake of a 2.5 percent fall in the Dow on Monday.
The Madrid general index opened down 1.44 percent to 583.85.
Later the indices came off initial lows to quote at around one percent lower, but dealers said the outlook for the day could be volatile and edgy.
